$Comment: What the trick-or-treat line hands over. The roll always pays a few sweets, and the library's
receipt toast lists what the knock paid and plays the pickup sound, so a knock is one sound,
even though sweets land in a wallet and not in the bag. It names no Cue for that reason. Then the
pool draws once: more sweets, a vanilla food, or a trick. Weight sets how often each comes up against the rest.
Sweets pay through the Currency reward kind. The tricks put a costume on the player through
the Costume reward kind; the player takes it off with /zigcostume off. A player already in a
costume, or under a transformation, keeps their look and gets a treat instead: each trick names
Hallows_Eve_Treats as its FallbackLootable, and that table pays whenever the costume cannot go on.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Trick_Or_Treat
